questions.text: English ___ in many countries all over the world.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Підмет English не виконує дію.
❌ Хибні: А) is speaking — Continuous не потрібен; В) speaks — активна форма не підходить; Г) speak — бракує допоміжного дієслова.
✅ Б) is spoken — Present Simple Passive: is + V3.

questions.text: This house ___ in 1950.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Рік у минулому — Past Simple Passive.
❌ Хибні: Б) has built — активна форма Perfect; В) is built — теперішній час не пасує до 1950; Г) built — активна форма, немає was.
✅ А) was built — Past Simple Passive: was + V3.

questions.text: The letters ___ yesterday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Yesterday + Passive — were + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) sent — немає допоміжного дієслова; Б) are sent — теперішній час не пасує; Г) was sent — був би однині.
✅ В) were sent — Past Simple Passive, множина.

questions.text: The window ___ by the boy.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Break — broke — broken.
❌ Хибні: А) is broke — неправильна форма дієслова; Б) broke — активна форма без was; Г) was break — потрібна форма V3.
✅ В) was broken — Past Simple Passive, V3 від break.

questions.text: Cars ___ in this factory.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Cars — are + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) are making — Continuous не потрібен; Б) make — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) is made — однина не пасує до cars.
✅ Г) are made — Present Simple Passive, множина.

questions.text: The cake ___ by my mother every Sunday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Every Sunday — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) was baked — минулий час не пасує до every Sunday; Б) is baking — Continuous не пасує до every Sunday; В) bakes — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ Г) is baked — Present Simple Passive.

questions.text: The thief ___ by the police last night.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last night — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) has been arrested — Perfect не вживається з last night; Б) arrested — немає допоміжного дієслова; В) is arrested — теперішній час не пасує до last night.
✅ Г) was arrested — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: Many books ___ by this author so far.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: So far — Present Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) have written — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) are written — Simple не пасує до so far; Г) had been written — Past Perfect не потрібен.
✅ Б) have been written — Present Perfect Passive.

questions.text: Don't come in! The room ___ now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Now — is being + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) cleans — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Б) is cleaned — Simple не для дії зараз; Г) has cleaned — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ В) is being cleaned — Present Continuous Passive.

questions.text: The bridge ___ next year.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Next year — will be + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) is built — теперішній час тут не пасує; В) will build — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) was built — минулий час тут не пасує.
✅ Б) will be built — Future Simple Passive.

questions.text: The homework ___ already.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Already — Present Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) did — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Б) was been done — неправильна форма be; В) has done — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ Г) has been done — Present Perfect Passive.

questions.text: Choose the correct passive form: «They speak French here.»
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Дієслово be + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) French speaks here. — активна форма без виконавця; В) French is speaking here. — Continuous не потрібен; Г) French spoken here. — бракує is у конструкції.
✅ Б) French is spoken here. — Present Simple Passive.

questions.text: Choose the correct passive form: «Shakespeare wrote Hamlet.»
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Write — wrote — written.
❌ Хибні: А) Hamlet was wrote by Shakespeare. — потрібна форма written; Б) Hamlet is written by Shakespeare. — Present не пасує до wrote; В) Hamlet wrote by Shakespeare. — бракує was та V3.
✅ Г) Hamlet was written by Shakespeare. — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: My bike ___ yesterday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Steal — stole — stolen.
❌ Хибні: А) has stolen — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) stole — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) is stolen — теперішній час тут не пасує.
✅ Б) was stolen — Past Simple Passive, V3 від steal.

questions.text: The pyramids ___ thousands of years ago.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Ago — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) have been built — Perfect не вживається з ago; В) was built — однина не пасує до pyramids; Г) are built — теперішній час не пасує до ago.
✅ Б) were built — Past Simple Passive, множина.

questions.text: The match ___ because of the rain.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Match — підмет, дія виконана над ним.
❌ Хибні: А) cancelled — немає допоміжного дієслова was; В) is cancelling — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) has cancel — неправильна форма дієслова.
✅ Б) was cancelled — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: Where ___ this photo taken last summer?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Photo — однина, дія в минулому.
❌ Хибні: Б) did — потрібне be, не do; В) is — теперішній час не пасує; Г) were — множина не пасує до photo.
✅ А) was — Past Simple Passive, однина.

questions.text: These shoes ___ in Italy.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Shoes — множина, are made.
❌ Хибні: А) made — немає допоміжного дієслова; В) is made — однина не пасує до shoes; Г) make — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ Б) are made — Present Simple Passive, множина.

questions.text: The results ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Tomorrow — майбутній час.
❌ Хибні: А) announced — немає допоміжного дієслова; Б) will announce — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) are announce — неправильна форма дієслова.
✅ Г) will be announced — Future Simple Passive.

questions.text: The documents must ___ by the director.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Модальне дієслово + be + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) sign — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Б) be signing — Continuous не потрібен; В) signed — бракує be у конструкції.
✅ Г) be signed — modal + be + V3.

questions.text: The telephone ___ by Alexander Bell.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Винахід у минулому — was invented.
❌ Хибні: А) invented — немає допоміжного дієслова; В) has invented — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) is invented — теперішній час тут не пасує.
✅ Б) was invented — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: This film ___ by millions of people.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: See — saw — seen.
❌ Хибні: А) was been seen — неправильна форма be; Б) is seeing — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) has seen — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ В) has been seen — Present Perfect Passive, V3 від see.

questions.text: If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Реальна умова — will + V.
❌ Хибні: Б) stayed — Past Simple не пасує до if it rains; В) stays — з підметом we немає -s; Г) would stay — це Second conditional.
✅ А) will stay — First conditional: will + V.

questions.text: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Закон природи — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) melting — неправильна форма дієслова; Б) melted — Past Simple не пасує; В) would melt — умовний спосіб не потрібен.
✅ Г) melts — Zero conditional: Present Simple.

questions.text: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If I were — нереальна умова.
❌ Хибні: А) will be — will не вживається після if; В) am — Present Simple не пасує до would; Г) would be — would не вживається після if.
✅ Б) were — Second conditional: if + Past Simple.

questions.text: If she studies hard, she ___ the exam.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Studies — Present Simple, наслідок — will + V.
❌ Хибні: Б) passed — Past Simple не підходить; В) passes — Present Simple не підходить; Г) would pass — це Second conditional.
✅ А) will pass — це First conditional: if + Present, will.

questions.text: If I had a car, I ___ to work by car.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If + Past Simple, would + V.
❌ Хибні: А) will drive — will для реальної умови; Б) drive — Present Simple не пасує до if I had; Г) drove — Past Simple не пасує в головній частині.
✅ В) would drive — Second conditional: would + V.

questions.text: I ___ you if I knew his number.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If I knew — would + V.
❌ Хибні: А) called — Past Simple не пасує в головній частині; Б) call — Present Simple не пасує; В) will call — will не пасує до if I knew.
✅ Г) would call — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: If he ___ late, we will start without him.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Після if — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) was — Past Simple не пасує до will; В) would be — would не вживається після if; Г) will be — will не вживається після if.
✅ А) is — First conditional: Present Simple.

questions.text: Unless you hurry, you ___ the train.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Unless = if you don't hurry.
❌ Хибні: А) missed — Past Simple не пасує; Б) would miss — це Second conditional; В) miss — Present Simple не пасує.
✅ Г) will miss — First conditional з unless.

questions.text: If water reaches 100°C, it ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Науковий факт — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) boiling — неправильна форма дієслова; Б) would boil — would не для закону природи; Г) boiled — Past Simple не пасує.
✅ В) boils — це Zero conditional: Present + Present.

questions.text: What would you do if you ___ a million dollars?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would you do — if + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) would win — would не вживається після if; В) will win — will не вживається після if; Г) win — Present Simple не пасує до would.
✅ А) won — Second conditional: if + Past Simple.

questions.text: If the weather is nice, we ___ for a picnic.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Реальна умова — will go.
❌ Хибні: А) went — Past Simple не пасує; Б) go would — неправильний порядок слів; Г) would go — це Second conditional.
✅ В) will go — це First conditional: if + Present, will.

questions.text: She would be happier if she ___ more friends.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would be — if + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) will have — will не вживається після if; Б) would have — would не вживається після if; Г) has — Present Simple не пасує до would.
✅ В) had — Second conditional: if + Past Simple.

questions.text: If I were you, I ___ him the truth.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If I were you — порада, would + V.
❌ Хибні: А) tell — Present Simple не пасує; Б) will tell — will не пасує до if I were you; В) told — Past Simple не пасує.
✅ Г) would tell — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: If you don't water plants, they ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Загальна істина — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) would die — would не для загальної істини; В) died — Past Simple не пасує; Г) dying — неправильна форма дієслова.
✅ А) die — це Zero conditional: Present + Present.

questions.text: We'll go to the beach if it ___ sunny tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Tomorrow, але після if — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) was — Past Simple не пасує до tomorrow; Б) will be — will не вживається після if; Г) would be — would не вживається після if.
✅ В) is — First conditional, Present Simple після if.

questions.text: If I ___ time, I would help you.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would help — if + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) have — Present Simple не пасує до would; В) would have — would не вживається після if; Г) will have — will не вживається після if.
✅ А) had — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: Which sentence is a first conditional?
options: If I had wings, I would fly.
If you heat ice, it melts.
If I had known, I would have helped.
If it rains, I will take an umbrella.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: First conditional — реальна умова.
❌ Хибні: А) If I had wings, I would fly. — це Second conditional; Б) If you heat ice, it melts. — це Zero conditional; В) If I had known, I would have helped. — це Third conditional.
✅ Г) If it rains, I will take an umbrella. — if + Present Simple, will + V.

questions.text: Which sentence is a second conditional?
options: If I had wings, I would fly.
If I had seen her, I would have said hello.
If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
If it rains, I will stay.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Second conditional — нереальна умова.
❌ Хибні: Б) If I had seen her, I would have said hello. — це Third conditional; В) If you mix red and blue, you get purple. — це Zero conditional; Г) If it rains, I will stay. — це First conditional.
✅ А) If I had wings, I would fly. — if + Past Simple, would + V.

questions.text: Which sentence means the same as «Unless you study, you will fail»?
options: If you study, you will fail.
If you don't study, you will fail.
If you studied, you would fail.
Unless you don't study, you will fail.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Unless — це if … not.
❌ Хибні: А) If you study, you will fail. — це протилежне значення; В) If you studied, you would fail. — інший тип умовного речення; Г) Unless you don't study, you will fail. — після unless немає not.
✅ Б) If you don't study, you will fail. — unless = if not.

questions.text: I'll call you as soon as I ___ home.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Після as soon as — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) got — Past Simple не пасує; В) am getting — Continuous не пасує; Г) will get — will не вживається після as soon as.
✅ А) get — у часових реченнях — Present Simple.

questions.text: If you ___ the button, the machine starts.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Інструкція — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) would press — would не пасує; Б) pressed — Past Simple не пасує; В) will press — will не для закону.
✅ Г) press — це Zero conditional: Present + Present.

questions.text: What ___ you do if you lost your keys?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If you lost → would you do.
❌ Хибні: Б) will — will не пасує до if you lost; В) did — потрібне would у головній частині; Г) do — потрібне would у головній частині.
✅ А) would — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: If I see him, I ___ him your message.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If I see — will + V.
❌ Хибні: А) give — Present Simple не пасує; В) gave — Past Simple не пасує; Г) would give — це Second conditional.
✅ Б) will give — це First conditional: if + Present, will.

questions.text: If we ___ the lottery, we would buy a house.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would buy — if + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) win — Present Simple не пасує до would; В) will win — will не вживається після if; Г) would win — would не вживається після if.
✅ А) won — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: The tickets ___ at the box office.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Tickets не продають самі — are sold.
❌ Хибні: А) sold — немає допоміжного дієслова; В) sell — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) are selling — Continuous не потрібен.
✅ Б) are sold — Present Simple Passive.

questions.text: The Eiffel Tower ___ every year by millions of tourists.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Every year — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) was visited — минулий час не пасує до every year; Б) visits — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) is visiting — активна форма Continuous.
✅ Г) is visited — Present Simple Passive.

questions.text: The boy ___ by a dog yesterday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Bite — bit — bitten.
❌ Хибні: А) has bitten — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Б) bit — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) is bitten — теперішній час не пасує до yesterday.
✅ В) was bitten — Past Simple Passive, V3 від bite.

questions.text: If you cool water to 0°C, it ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Закон природи — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) freezing — неправильна форма дієслова; В) froze — Past Simple не пасує; Г) would freeze — would не для закону природи.
✅ А) freezes — це Zero conditional: Present + Present.

questions.text: The old church ___ at the moment.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: At the moment — is being + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) restores — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) has restored — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) is restored — Simple не передає процес зараз.
✅ Б) is being restored — Present Continuous Passive.

questions.text: At 7 o'clock yesterday the new road ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Певний момент у минулому — was being.
❌ Хибні: А) was built — Simple не передає процес; Б) is being built — теперішній час не пасує; Г) has been built — Perfect не пасує до yesterday.
✅ В) was being built — Past Continuous Passive.

questions.text: The problem ___ for two hours, but they haven't found a solution.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: For two hours + результат — Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) was discussed — Past Simple не пасує до haven't found; В) is discussed — Simple не пасує до for two hours; Г) discusses — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ Б) has been discussed — Present Perfect Passive.

questions.text: The new law ___ next month.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Next month — will be + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) introduced — Past Simple не пасує до next month; Б) will introduce — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) has introduced — активна форма Perfect.
✅ Г) will be introduced — Future Simple Passive.

questions.text: A present ___ to her by her uncle on her birthday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Give — gave — given.
❌ Хибні: А) was been given — неправильна форма be; Б) gave — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) has give — неправильна форма дієслова.
✅ В) was given — Past Simple Passive, V3 від give.

questions.text: I ___ my hair cut every month.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Have something done — зробили не самі.
❌ Хибні: А) make — make змінює значення; Б) am — be не утворює causative; Г) do — do не утворює causative.
✅ В) have — causative: have + object + V3.

questions.text: We ___ our house painted last week.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last week — had + object + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) have — Present не пасує до last week; В) were — be не утворює causative; Г) made — make змінює значення.
✅ Б) had — causative у Past Simple.

questions.text: Which sentence with a verb of perception in the passive is correct?
options: He was seen to enter the house.
He was seen entered the house.
He saw to enter the house.
He was seen enter the house.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Passive: was seen + to V.
❌ Хибні: Б) He was seen entered the house. — після was seen немає V2; В) He saw to enter the house. — активна форма змінює зміст; Г) He was seen enter the house. — у Passive після seen потрібне to.
✅ А) He was seen to enter the house. — passive із to-infinitive після seen.

questions.text: He is said ___ in London.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Is said + to V.
❌ Хибні: А) live — потрібне to у цій конструкції; В) lives — присудок уже є — is said; Г) living — після is said потрібне to V.
✅ Б) to live — impersonal passive + to-infinitive.

questions.text: The documents should ___ in a safe place.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Should + be + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) be keeping — активна форма Continuous; Б) kept — бракує be у конструкції; Г) keep — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ В) be kept — modal + be + V3.

questions.text: She hates ___ at.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Passive gerund: being + V3.
❌ Хибні: Б) to laugh — неправильна форма дієслова; В) laughed — після hates потрібне being; Г) laughing — бракує об'єкта й being.
✅ А) being laughed — after hate — being + V3.

questions.text: By whom ___ the Mona Lisa painted?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Mona Lisa — однина, минулий час.
❌ Хибні: А) were — однина не пасує до Mona Lisa; Б) did — do не утворює Passive; В) has — бракує been у конструкції.
✅ Г) was — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: «They have cancelled all flights.» Choose the passive form.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Have/has been + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) All flights have cancelled. — активна форма без been; Б) All flights are cancel. — неправильна форма дієслова; Г) All flights were been cancelled. — неправильна форма be.
✅ В) All flights have been cancelled. — Present Perfect Passive.

questions.text: «People say that he is a spy.» Choose the correct form.
options: He is said being a spy.
He said to be a spy.
He is said to be a spy.
He says to be a spy.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Say → is said to V.
❌ Хибні: А) He is said being a spy. — після is said потрібне to; Б) He said to be a spy. — Past Simple активне, не Passive; Г) He says to be a spy. — Passive потрібен — says активне.
✅ В) He is said to be a spy. — impersonal passive: is said + to V.

questions.text: I was told ___ the door.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Was told + to V.
❌ Хибні: Б) locked — неправильна форма дієслова; В) locking — після was told потрібне to V; Г) lock — бракує to у конструкції.
✅ А) to lock — passive + to-infinitive.

questions.text: The car ___ repaired tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Going to + be + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) is going to — бракує be у конструкції; В) will being — неправильна форма дієслова; Г) goes to be — неправильна форма дієслова.
✅ Б) is going to be — going to Passive.

questions.text: She ___ to the party but she didn't go.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Вона — об'єкт запрошення.
❌ Хибні: А) invited — активна форма без об'єкта; Б) has invited — активна форма Perfect; В) was inviting — активна форма Continuous.
✅ Г) was invited — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: The children ___ a story by the teacher.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Children — множина, were + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) were telling — активна форма Continuous; Б) have tell — неправильна форма дієслова; Г) told — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ В) were told — Past Simple Passive, множина.

questions.text: The ship ___ by a huge wave.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Hit — hit — hit.
❌ Хибні: А) is hitting — активна форма Continuous; Б) hit — бракує was у конструкції; Г) was hitted — неправильна форма V3.
✅ В) was hit — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: The injured ___ to hospital by ambulance.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Take — took — taken.
❌ Хибні: А) took — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Б) have took — неправильна форма дієслова; Г) were took — потрібна форма V3 — taken.
✅ В) were taken — Past Simple Passive, множина.

questions.text: The painting ___ stolen from the museum last night.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last night — was stolen.
❌ Хибні: А) is — теперішній час не пасує до last night; В) has been — Perfect не вживається з last night; Г) had — Past Perfect не потрібен.
✅ Б) was — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: This room ___ for storage.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Room — об'єкт використання.
❌ Хибні: А) used — бракує is у конструкції; Б) is using — активна форма Continuous; В) uses — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ Г) is used — Present Simple Passive.

questions.text: «Someone has stolen my wallet.» Choose the passive form.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Passive зберігає час активної форми.
❌ Хибні: А) My wallet was stolen. — змінено час дієслова; В) My wallet is stolen. — змінено час дієслова; Г) My wallet has stolen. — бракує been у конструкції.
✅ Б) My wallet has been stolen. — Present Perfect Passive.

questions.text: The exhibition ___ until the end of May.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Exhibition не проводить, її проводять.
❌ Хибні: А) has held — активна форма Perfect; Б) will hold — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) holds — активна форма Present.
✅ Г) will be held — Future Simple Passive.

questions.text: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: The accident was happened last night.
The accident has been happened last night.
The accident was occurred last night.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Happen, occur, arrive — без Passive.
❌ Хибні: А) The accident was happened last night. — happen не вживається в Passive; Б) The accident has been happened last night. — happen не вживається в Passive; Г) The accident was occurred last night. — occur не вживається в Passive.
✅ В) The accident happened last night. — happen — неперехідне, Passive неможливий.

questions.text: If I had known about the problem, I ___ you.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If + Past Perfect → would have + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) had helped — Past Perfect не в головній частині; Б) would help — це Second conditional; В) will help — це First conditional.
✅ Г) would have helped — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: If she ___ the bus, she wouldn't have been late.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Wouldn't have been — if + had V3.
❌ Хибні: А) wouldn't miss — would не вживається після if; В) doesn't miss — Present Simple не пасує; Г) didn't miss — Past Simple не для минулого нереального.
✅ Б) hadn't missed — Third conditional: if + Past Perfect.

questions.text: If it ___ rained, we would have played football.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If it hadn't rained.
❌ Хибні: Б) hasn't — Present Perfect не пасує; В) didn't — Past Simple не пасує; Г) wouldn't — would не вживається після if.
✅ А) hadn't — Third conditional: if + hadn't + V3.

questions.text: I wish I ___ speak French.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Wish + could (здатність).
❌ Хибні: А) would — would не вживається для здібності; В) can — Present Simple не пасує до wish; Г) will — will не вживається після wish.
✅ Б) could — wish + could — теперішня неможливість.

questions.text: I wish I ___ the answer yesterday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Yesterday → wish + had V3.
❌ Хибні: А) have known — бракує had у конструкції; Б) would know — would не про минуле; Г) knew — Past Simple стосується теперішнього.
✅ В) had known — wish + Past Perfect — жаль про минуле.

questions.text: If only I ___ more money now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Now → if only + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) have — Present Simple не пасує; В) will have — will не вживається після if only; Г) would have — would не вживається після if only.
✅ А) had — if only + Past Simple — зараз.

questions.text: If he had studied harder, he ___ the exam.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Had studied → would have passed.
❌ Хибні: А) will pass — це First conditional; Б) had passed — Past Perfect не в головній частині; Г) would pass — це Second conditional.
✅ В) would have passed — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: Suppose you ___ the chance, would you accept it?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would you accept — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) have — Present не пасує до would you; В) will have — will не вживається після suppose; Г) would have — would не вживається після suppose.
✅ А) had — suppose + Past Simple — нереальна ситуація.

questions.text: You can borrow my car provided you ___ careful.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Provided (that) — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) would be — would не вживається після provided; Б) being — неправильна форма дієслова; Г) will be — will не вживається після provided.
✅ В) are — provided + Present Simple.

questions.text: I'll take an umbrella in case it ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: In case — без will.
❌ Хибні: А) rained — Past Simple не пасує до I'll take; Б) will rain — will не вживається після in case; Г) would rain — would не вживається після in case.
✅ В) rains — після in case — Present Simple.

questions.text: If I ___ you, I'd apologise.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If I were you.
❌ Хибні: А) will be — will не вживається після if; В) am — Present не пасує до would; Г) had been — Past Perfect не пасує до would.
✅ Б) were — if I were you — порада.

questions.text: As long as you ___ me, I'll stay.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: As long as — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) would need — would не вживається після as long as; В) needed — Past Simple не пасує до I'll stay; Г) will need — will не вживається після as long as.
✅ Б) need — as long as + Present Simple.

questions.text: If she weren't so tired, she ___ out with us.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Weren't — would + V.
❌ Хибні: А) would have gone — це Third conditional; Б) went — Past Simple не в головній частині; Г) will go — це First conditional.
✅ В) would go — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: I wouldn't have bought it if I ___ the price.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Wouldn't have bought — had known.
❌ Хибні: А) knew — Past Simple не пасує до would have; Б) have known — бракує had у конструкції; В) would know — would не вживається після if.
✅ Г) had known — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: If I had studied harder at school, I ___ at university now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Now → would + V.
❌ Хибні: А) had been — Past Perfect не в головній частині; В) will be — will не пасує до if I had studied; Г) would have been — це Third conditional.
✅ Б) would be — mixed conditional: теперішній наслідок.

questions.text: Unless it ___, we'll go to the park.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Unless — без not.
❌ Хибні: Б) rained — Past Simple не пасує до we'll go; В) doesn't rain — unless уже містить заперечення; Г) will rain — will не вживається після unless.
✅ А) rains — unless + стверджувальна форма.

questions.text: If you ___ any questions, please ask.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If you have — реальна умова.
❌ Хибні: А) having — неправильна форма дієслова; Б) will have — will не вживається після if; В) would have — would не вживається після if.
✅ Г) have — реальна умова: Present Simple.

questions.text: He ___ the race if he hadn't been injured.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If he hadn't been → would have won.
❌ Хибні: Б) would win — це Second conditional; В) will win — це First conditional; Г) had won — Past Perfect не в головній частині.
✅ А) would have won — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: What would have happened if she ___ the job?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would have happened — had accepted.
❌ Хибні: А) accepted — Past Simple не пасує до would have; В) would accept — would не вживається після if; Г) has accepted — Present Perfect не пасує.
✅ Б) had accepted — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: Which sentence is a third conditional?
options: If I had seen him, I would have told him.
If I see him, I will tell him.
If I see him, I tell him.
If I saw him, I would tell him.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Third — нереальне минуле.
❌ Хибні: Б) If I see him, I will tell him. — це First conditional; В) If I see him, I tell him. — це Zero conditional; Г) If I saw him, I would tell him. — це Second conditional.
✅ А) If I had seen him, I would have told him. — if + Past Perfect, would have + V3.

questions.text: I wish he ___ so loudly.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Wish + wouldn't про звичку.
❌ Хибні: А) hasn't talked — Perfect не пасує до wish; Б) isn't talking — Continuous не пасує до wish; Г) won't talk — will не вживається після wish.
✅ В) wouldn't talk — wish + would — роздратування.

questions.text: If you had told me earlier, I ___ it.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Had told → would have fixed.
❌ Хибні: А) would fix — це Second conditional; В) had fixed — Past Perfect не в головній частині; Г) will fix — це First conditional.
✅ Б) would have fixed — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: If he had taken my advice, he ___ in trouble now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Now → would + V.
❌ Хибні: А) wouldn't have been — now вказує на теперішнє; В) hadn't been — Past Perfect не в головній частині; Г) won't be — will не пасує до had taken.
✅ Б) wouldn't be — це змішаний тип умовного.

questions.text: I ___ happy if you came to my party.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If you came — would be.
❌ Хибні: Б) will be — це First conditional; В) would have been — це Third conditional; Г) am — Present Simple не пасує до if you came.
✅ А) would be — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: Which conditional sentence is correct?
options: If I will see her, I will tell her.
If I would see her, I would tell her.
If I saw her, I will tell her.
If I see her, I will tell her.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: After if — без will/would.
❌ Хибні: А) If I will see her, I will tell her. — will не вживається після if; Б) If I would see her, I would tell her. — would не вживається після if; В) If I saw her, I will tell her. — Past Simple не пасує до will.
✅ Г) If I see her, I will tell her. — це First conditional: if + Present, will.

questions.text: The new laboratory ___ by the time the accreditation team arrives next month.
questions.explanation:
💡 Завершення до майбутнього моменту в пасиві: Future Perfect Passive.
❌ А) активна форма; В) граматично неправильна форма; Г) Present Simple Passive не передає завершення до майбутньої межі.
✅ Б) will have been completed — will have been + V3.

questions.text: If the data ___ before the update, the error could have been avoided.
questions.explanation:
💡 Third Conditional: if + Past Perfect, would/could have + V3. У цьому реченні підмет data виконує дію backup у значенні зробив резервну копію.
❌ Б) пасивна форма змінює значення; В) would не ставимо в if-clause; Г) Present Perfect не відповідає минулій нереальній умові.
✅ А) had backed up — Past Perfect Active.

questions.text: The applicants are expected ___ by email before the end of the week.
questions.explanation:
💡 Applicants отримують повідомлення, тому потрібен пасивний інфінітив.
❌ А) активне значення; В) герундій не підходить після are expected; Г) неправильно утворена форма.
✅ Б) to be contacted — to be + V3.

questions.text: Had the instructions been clearer, the device ___ incorrectly.
questions.explanation:
💡 Had + підмет + V3 — інверсія Third Conditional. Наслідок також має бути в пасиві.
❌ Б) майбутній час; В) активна форма; Г) Past Perfect не утворює наслідок умовного речення.
✅ А) would not have been installed — would have been + V3.

questions.text: The old computers need ___ before they can be used in the classroom.
questions.explanation:
💡 Need + V-ing може мати пасивне значення: computers need repairing = need to be repaired.
❌ А) бракує пасивної конструкції; В) граматично неправильно; Г) потрібне допоміжне дієслово або -ing форма.
✅ Б) repairing — герундій із пасивним значенням.

questions.text: The minister is reported ___ the proposal before the committee rejected it.
questions.explanation:
💡 Після is reported потрібен інфінітив; дія перед rejected — раніша, тому Perfect Infinitive.
❌ А) не показує попередність; В) і Г) герундій не підходить до reporting passive.
✅ Б) to have withdrawn — повідомляють про ранішу дію.

questions.text: I hate ___ what to do, especially when I have already considered every option.
questions.explanation:
💡 Людині не подобається, коли їй наказують; потрібен пасивний герундій після hate.
❌ А) активна форма; В) означає, що мовець сам комусь говорить; Г) активний Perfect Gerund.
✅ Б) being told — бути тим, кому говорять.

questions.text: The missing files may ___ during the transfer, but the cause is still unknown.
questions.explanation:
💡 May + Perfect Passive Infinitive виражає можливу завершену дію над файлами.
❌ Б) активний Continuous; В) активна форма; Г) після may не можна ставити просто being.
✅ А) have been deleted — may have been + V3.

questions.text: If the samples were stored at a lower temperature, they ___ for longer.
questions.explanation:
💡 Second Conditional у пасиві: if + Past Simple Passive, would + be + V3.
❌ А) Future Simple; Б) активна форма; Г) Third Conditional не відповідає теперішній гіпотезі.
✅ В) would be preserved — зразки зберігалися б.

questions.text: No sooner ___ than the fire alarm started.
questions.explanation:
💡 No sooner на початку вимагає інверсії Past Perfect; двері були замкнені, тому пасив.
❌ А) немає інверсії; В) неправильний час і значення; Г) активна форма та немає Perfect.
✅ Б) had the doors been locked — had + підмет + been + V3.

questions.text: No sooner ___ the problem been solved than another one appeared.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: No sooner had… than….
❌ Хибні: А) has — Present Perfect не пасує до appeared; В) did — do не пасує до been solved; Г) was — бракує been у конструкції.
✅ Б) had — інверсія: no sooner + had + підмет.

questions.text: Not only ___ the money stolen, but the car was also damaged.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Not only was the money stolen.
❌ Хибні: А) did — do не утворює Passive; Б) had — бракує been у конструкції; В) were — money — однина, не множина.
✅ Г) was — інверсія в Passive.

questions.text: The old man is thought ___ a fortune when he died.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: When he died — to have V3.
❌ Хибні: А) having left — неправильна форма дієслова; Б) leaving — неправильна форма дієслова; В) to leave — теперішня дія тут не пасує.
✅ Г) to have left — perfect infinitive: to have + V3.

questions.text: The exam papers ___ by the time the results are published.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: By the time + Present → will have been.
❌ Хибні: Б) will mark — активна форма — потрібен Passive; В) are marking — активна форма Continuous; Г) have marked — активна форма Perfect.
✅ А) will have been marked — Future Perfect Passive.

questions.text: The workers ___ for two months, so they've decided to strike.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: For two months — Present Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) hadn't paid — Past Perfect не пасує; В) haven't paid — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) aren't paying — активна форма Continuous.
✅ Б) haven't been paid — Present Perfect Passive.

questions.text: She doesn't like ___ what to do.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Like + being + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) to tell — неправильна форма дієслова; В) telling — активна форма без об'єкта; Г) told — бракує being у конструкції.
✅ Б) being told — like + being V3.

questions.text: «It is reported that the president has resigned.» Choose the correct form.
options: The president is reported to have resigned.
The president is reported to resign.
The president reports to have resigned.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Resigned — минула дія, to have V3.
❌ Хибні: Б) The president was reported resigning. — неправильна граматична конструкція; В) The president is reported to resign. — теперішня дія тут не пасує; Г) The president reports to have resigned. — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ А) The president is reported to have resigned. — perfect infinitive після is reported.

questions.text: The machine ___ checked before use.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Have to + be + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) has to — бракує be у конструкції; Б) is have to — неправильна форма дієслова; В) has be — неправильна форма дієслова.
✅ Г) has to be — modal + be + V3.

questions.text: Which sentence is incorrect?
options: The house is belonged to my uncle.
The book was written by a famous author.
The house belongs to my uncle.
The window was broken by the wind.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Belong — неперехідне дієслово.
❌ Хибні: Б) The book was written by a famous author. — це правильне Passive; В) The house belongs to my uncle. — правильна активна форма; Г) The window was broken by the wind. — це правильне Passive.
✅ А) The house is belonged to my uncle. — belong не вживається в Passive.

questions.text: «They are painting the fence.» Choose the passive form.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Continuous → is being + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) The fence was painting. — неправильна форма дієслова; В) The fence is painted. — Simple без процесу; Г) The fence has painted. — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ Б) The fence is being painted. — Present Continuous Passive.

questions.text: «People must not touch the exhibits.» Choose the passive form.
options: The exhibits not must be touched.
The exhibits must be not touched.
The exhibits must not be touched.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Must + not + be + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) The exhibits not must be touched. — неправильний порядок слів; Б) The exhibits must be not touched. — неправильний порядок слів; Г) The exhibits must not touch. — активна форма — потрібен Passive.
✅ В) The exhibits must not be touched. — modal + not + be + V3.

questions.text: It ___ yesterday that the museum will close for repairs.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: It was announced that….
❌ Хибні: Б) announced — бракує was у конструкції; В) was announcing — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) has announce — неправильна форма дієслова.
✅ А) was announced — impersonal passive: it is said that.

questions.text: The prisoners are known ___ through the tunnel last night.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last night — to have V3.
❌ Хибні: А) to be escape — неправильна форма дієслова; В) escaping — неправильна форма дієслова; Г) to escape — теперішня дія тут не пасує.
✅ Б) to have escaped — perfect infinitive: to have + V3.

questions.text: The staff ___ of the changes yesterday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Staff — об'єкт інформування.
❌ Хибні: Б) have informed — активна форма Perfect; В) informed — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) were informing — активна форма Continuous.
✅ А) were informed — Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: The teacher asked us to be quiet. Choose the correct passive.
options: We were asking to be quiet.
We were asked to be quiet.
We have asked to be quiet.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Asked us → we were asked.
❌ Хибні: А) We were asking to be quiet. — активна форма Continuous; В) We asked to be quiet. — активна форма — потрібен Passive; Г) We have asked to be quiet. — активна форма Perfect.
✅ Б) We were asked to be quiet. — Past Simple Passive + to V.

questions.text: ___ I known about the delay, I would have booked another flight.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Had I known = If I had known.
❌ Хибні: А) Were — Were — для Second conditional; В) Should — Should — для First conditional; Г) If — if не поєднується з інверсією.
✅ Б) Had — інверсія Third conditional.

questions.text: ___ you need any help, please contact me.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Should you need = If you need.
❌ Хибні: А) Had — Had — для Third conditional; Б) Would — would не утворює інверсії; Г) Were — Were — для Second conditional.
✅ В) Should — інверсія First conditional.

questions.text: ___ I you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Were I you = If I were you.
❌ Хибні: А) Should — Should — для First conditional; Б) Had — Had — для Third conditional; Г) Was — Was не утворює інверсії.
✅ В) Were — інверсія Second conditional.

questions.text: But for your help last year, I ___ the exam.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last year → would have + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) had failed — Past Perfect не в головній частині; В) would fail — це Second conditional; Г) will fail — це First conditional.
✅ Б) would have failed — Third conditional: but for = if it hadn't been for.

questions.text: If it ___ for his advice, I would have lost everything.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If it hadn't been for….
❌ Хибні: Б) weren't — це Second conditional: if + Past, would; В) wasn't — Past Simple не пасує до would have; Г) hasn't been — Present Perfect не пасує.
✅ А) hadn't been — if it hadn't been for = but for.

questions.text: If you happen ___ him, give him my regards.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Happen to V — випадково.
❌ Хибні: А) seeing — неправильна форма дієслова; В) to be seen — потрібна активна форма; Г) see — бракує to у конструкції.
✅ Б) to see — happen to + V — випадково.

questions.text: It's high time you ___ to bed.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: It's time — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) will go — will не вживається після it's time; В) had gone — Past Perfect не пасує; Г) go — Present Simple не пасує.
✅ Б) went — it's time + Past Simple.

questions.text: I wish I ___ so much last night.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last night → wish + hadn't V3.
❌ Хибні: А) didn't eat — Past Simple стосується теперішнього; Б) wouldn't eat — would не про минуле; В) haven't eaten — Present Perfect не пасує до wish.
✅ Г) hadn't eaten — wish + Past Perfect — жаль про минуле.

questions.text: If only she ___ listened to me!
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If only + had + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) did — do не утворює Past Perfect; Б) has — Present Perfect не пасує; В) would — would не пасує до listened.
✅ Г) had — if only + Past Perfect — жаль про минуле.

questions.text: If I hadn't broken my leg, I ___ in the match tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Tomorrow — would be + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: А) will play — will не пасує до if I hadn't broken; Б) would have played — це Third conditional; Г) had played — Past Perfect не в головній частині.
✅ В) would be playing — mixed conditional: майбутній наслідок.

questions.text: She would have won the race if she ___ so nervous.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would have won — hadn't been.
❌ Хибні: А) wasn't — Past Simple не пасує до would have; В) weren't — це Second conditional; Г) hasn't been — Present Perfect не пасує.
✅ Б) hadn't been — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: ___ it not for the rain, we would be sitting outside now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Were it not for = if it weren't for.
❌ Хибні: А) Was — Was не утворює інверсії; Б) Should — Should — для First conditional; Г) Had — Had — для Third conditional.
✅ В) Were — інверсія Second conditional: were it not for.

questions.text: Supposing you ___ lost, what would you do?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would you do → supposing + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) would get — would не вживається після supposing; В) will get — will не вживається після supposing; Г) get — Present Simple не пасує до would you.
✅ А) got — suppose + Past Simple.

questions.text: You can use my laptop on condition that you ___ it back tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: On condition that — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) would bring — would не вживається після on condition that; Б) brought — Past Simple не пасує до tomorrow; В) will bring — will не вживається після on condition that.
✅ Г) bring — on condition that + Present Simple.

questions.text: Which sentence expresses regret about the past?
options: I wish I had studied more.
I wish I will study more.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Regret about the past → had V3.
❌ Хибні: А) I wish I study more. — Present не вживається після wish; В) I wish I studied more. — wish + Past Simple — про теперішнє; Г) I wish I will study more. — will не вживається після wish.
✅ Б) I wish I had studied more. — wish + Past Perfect.

questions.text: Which conditional sentence is grammatically correct?
options: If I have had time, I would help.
If I will have time, I would help.
If I had time, I would help.
If I would have time, I would help.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If + Past Simple, would + V.
❌ Хибні: А) If I have had time, I would help. — неправильне поєднання часів; Б) If I will have time, I would help. — will не вживається після if; Г) If I would have time, I would help. — would не вживається після if.
✅ В) If I had time, I would help. — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: If you hadn't asked me, I ___ there.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Hadn't asked → wouldn't have gone.
❌ Хибні: Б) wouldn't go — це Second conditional; В) won't go — це First conditional; Г) didn't go — Past Simple не в головній частині.
✅ А) wouldn't have gone — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: Unless he ___ harder, he won't pass the test.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Unless he works = if he doesn't work.
❌ Хибні: А) will work — will не вживається після unless; В) worked — Past Simple не пасує до won't pass; Г) doesn't work — unless уже містить заперечення.
✅ Б) works — unless + стверджувальна форма.

questions.text: Had she not left early, she ___ the accident.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Had she not left = if she hadn't left.
❌ Хибні: А) will witness — це First conditional; Б) had witnessed — Past Perfect не в головній частині; Г) would witness — це Second conditional.
✅ В) would have witnessed — Third conditional (інверсія).

questions.text: If he ___ so stubborn, we could solve the problem easily.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Could solve — if + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) isn't — Present Simple не пасує до could; В) wouldn't be — would не вживається після if; Г) hadn't been — це Third conditional.
✅ А) weren't — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: I'd have gone to the party if I ___ invited.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Had been invited — Past Perfect Passive.
❌ Хибні: А) would be — would не вживається після if; Б) were — це Second conditional; В) was — Past Simple не пасує до would have.
✅ Г) had been — Third conditional + Passive.

questions.text: What if the train ___ late tomorrow?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: What if + Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) will be — will не вживається після what if; В) was — Past Simple не пасує до tomorrow; Г) would be — would не вживається після what if.
✅ А) is — what if + Present Simple.

questions.text: Even if you ___ me a million dollars, I wouldn't do it.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Wouldn't do — even if + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) had offered — це Third conditional; В) offer — Present Simple не пасує до wouldn't; Г) will offer — will не вживається після even if.
✅ А) offered — це Second conditional: if + Past, would.

questions.text: If they hadn't repaired the road, we ___ stuck for hours.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Hadn't repaired → would have been.
❌ Хибні: А) had been — Past Perfect не в головній частині; Б) will be — це First conditional; Г) would be — це Second conditional.
✅ В) would have been — це Third conditional: if + had V3.

questions.text: Which sentence is a mixed conditional?
options: If I had a better job, I would be happier.
If I work harder, I will get a better job.
If I had worked harder, I would have a better job now.
If I had worked harder, I would have passed.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Mixed — минуле + теперішній наслідок.
❌ Хибні: А) If I had a better job, I would be happier. — це Second conditional; Б) If I work harder, I will get a better job. — це First conditional; Г) If I had worked harder, I would have passed. — це Third conditional.
✅ В) If I had worked harder, I would have a better job now. — минула умова + теперішній наслідок.

questions.text: They promised that if they ___ the contract, they would send it by courier.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Promised → would + if + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) sign — Present Simple не пасує до promised; В) will sign — will не вживається після if; Г) have signed — Present Perfect не пасує до promised.
✅ Б) signed — Past Simple у непрямій мові.

cards.question: Passive Voice (форма)
cards.answer: be (у потрібному часі) + V3: is made, was built, has been done, will be sent. Підмет — об'єкт дії.

cards.question: Present Simple Passive
cards.answer: am/is/are + V3: English is spoken here. Дія як факт чи звичка.

cards.question: Past Simple Passive
cards.answer: was/were + V3: The house was built in 1950.

cards.question: Present Perfect Passive
cards.answer: have/has been + V3: The work has been done.

cards.question: Continuous Passive
cards.answer: is/are being + V3 (Present), was/were being + V3 (Past): The room is being cleaned.

cards.question: Future Simple Passive
cards.answer: will be + V3: The bridge will be built next year.

cards.question: Модальні дієслова в Passive
cards.answer: modal + be + V3: must be signed, can be seen; у минулому: modal + have been + V3 (should have been done).

cards.question: Agent: by / with
cards.answer: by + виконавець (written by Tolstoy); with + інструмент (cut with a knife).

cards.question: Дієслова без Passive
cards.answer: Неперехідні дієслова (happen, arrive, belong, sleep, die, exist) не мають Passive: The accident happened (не «was happened»).

cards.question: Causative: have something done
cards.answer: have/get + object + V3: I had my hair cut (мені підстригли — зробив хтось інший).

cards.question: Impersonal Passive
cards.answer: It is said that… / He is said to be… / He is said to have left…; також believed, thought, known, reported, expected.

cards.question: Passive + V-ing / to V
cards.answer: After prepositions/likes: being + V3 (I hate being laughed at); to be + V3 (She wants to be invited).

cards.question: Zero conditional
cards.answer: If + Present Simple, Present Simple: If you heat ice, it melts. Закони природи, факти.

cards.question: First conditional
cards.answer: If + Present Simple, will + V: If it rains, we will stay at home. Реальна можливість у майбутньому.

cards.question: Second conditional
cards.answer: If + Past Simple, would + V: If I had a car, I would drive. Нереальна/малоймовірна ситуація зараз; if I were you…

cards.question: Third conditional
cards.answer: If + Past Perfect, would have + V3: If I had known, I would have helped. Нереальна ситуація в минулому.

cards.question: Mixed conditional
cards.answer: If + Past Perfect, would + V (теперішній наслідок минулої умови): If I had studied, I would have a job now.

cards.question: Unless
cards.answer: Unless = if … not: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train. Після unless — стверджувальна форма!

cards.question: as long as / provided (that) / on condition that
cards.answer: Умова «за умови, що»: You can go provided (that) you finish your work.

cards.question: in case
cards.answer: «на випадок, якщо»: Take an umbrella in case it rains (не буде will після in case).

cards.question: Time clauses
cards.answer: after when, as soon as, before, until, after — Present Simple для майбутнього: I'll call you as soon as I get home.

cards.question: Wish / If only
cards.answer: wish + Past Simple (теперішнє), wish + Past Perfect (минуле), wish + would (роздратування): I wish I knew. I wish I had gone. I wish he would stop.

cards.question: Inversion in conditionals
cards.answer: Had I known… (= If I had known); Were I you… (= If I were you); Should you need help… (= If you should need help).

cards.question: But for / Otherwise
cards.answer: But for your help, I would have failed (= if it hadn't been for). Otherwise = інакше.

cards.question: It's high time
cards.answer: It's (high) time + Past Simple: It's time you went to bed (давно пора).

cards.question: will/would після if
cards.answer: Після if не вживаємо will/would у частині умови: If it rains (не will rain).
